tests.name: test_search_available_rooms_nightly_rate_calculation
tests.description: Verify nightly_rate is correctly calculated as price_per_night_credits * price_modifier

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM TABLE(space.hotel.search_available_rooms('2099-07-01', '2099-07-05')) WHERE hotel_name = 'Lunar Grand Hyatt' AND room_type_name = 'Zero-G Pod'
steps.description: Zero-G Pod at Lunar Grand Hyatt should appear in results

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM TABLE(space.hotel.search_available_rooms('2099-07-01', '2099-07-05')) WHERE hotel_name = 'Lunar Grand Hyatt' AND room_type_name = 'Zero-G Pod' AND nightly_rate = 9500.0 * 2.5
steps.description: Nightly rate for Zero-G Pod should be 9500 * 2.5 = 23750

tests.name: test_search_available_rooms_ordered_by_nightly_rate
tests.description: Verify results are ordered by nightly_rate ascending

steps.sql: SELECT nightly_rate FROM TABLE(space.hotel.search_available_rooms('2099-08-01', '2099-08-05')) ORDER BY nightly_rate
steps.description: Should return results ordered by nightly rate

steps.sql: WITH results AS (SELECT nightly_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY nightly_rate) AS rn FROM TABLE(space.hotel.search_available_rooms('2099-08-01', '2099-08-05'))) SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM results r1 JOIN results r2 ON r1.rn = r2.rn - 1 WHERE r1.nightly_rate > r2.nightly_rate
steps.description: No row should have a higher nightly_rate than the next row (cnt should be 0)

tests.name: test_cancel_reservation_changes_status
tests.description: Verify cancel_reservation sets status to Cancelled for an existing reservation

steps.sql: CALL space.hotel.make_reservation('TRV-001', 'HTL-002', 'RT-004', '2099-11-01', '2099-11-04', '1')
steps.description: Create a test reservation to cancel

steps.sql: SELECT reservation_id FROM space.hotel.reservations WHERE traveler_id = 'TRV-001' AND hotel_id = 'HTL-002' AND check_in_date = '2099-11-01' AND check_out_date = '2099-11-04' AND status = 'Confirmed' LIMIT 1
steps.description: Test reservation should exist with Confirmed status

steps.sql: CALL space.hotel.cancel_reservation((SELECT reservation_id FROM space.hotel.reservations WHERE traveler_id = 'TRV-001' AND hotel_id = 'HTL-002' AND check_in_date = '2099-11-01' AND check_out_date = '2099-11-04' AND status = 'Confirmed' LIMIT 1))
steps.description: Cancel the test reservation

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM space.hotel.reservations WHERE traveler_id = 'TRV-001' AND hotel_id = 'HTL-002' AND check_in_date = '2099-11-01' AND check_out_date = '2099-11-04' AND status = 'Cancelled'
steps.description: Reservation status should now be Cancelled

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM space.hotel.reservations WHERE traveler_id = 'TRV-001' AND hotel_id = 'HTL-002' AND check_in_date = '2099-11-01' AND check_out_date = '2099-11-04' AND status = 'Confirmed'
steps.description: No Confirmed reservation should remain for those dates

tests.name: test_cancel_reservation_existing_completed
tests.description: Verify cancel_reservation can update a Completed reservation to Cancelled

steps.sql: SELECT status FROM space.hotel.reservations WHERE reservation_id = 'RES-00001'
steps.description: RES-00001 should exist

steps.sql: CALL space.hotel.cancel_reservation('RES-00001')
steps.description: Cancel reservation RES-00001

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM space.hotel.reservations WHERE reservation_id = 'RES-00001' AND status = 'Cancelled'
steps.description: RES-00001 should now be Cancelled

steps.sql: UPDATE space.hotel.reservations SET status = 'Completed' WHERE reservation_id = 'RES-00001'
steps.description: Restore RES-00001 to Completed for cleanup

tests.name: test_modify_reservation_updates_dates_and_cost

steps.description: Reservation should reflect updated dates and room type

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM space.hotel.reservations WHERE traveler_id = 'TRV-002' AND hotel_id = 'HTL-001' AND check_in_date = '2099-12-10' AND check_out_date = '2099-12-15' AND room_type_id = 'RT-002' AND total_cost_credits = 5 * 9500.0 * 3.5
